messages:
Nora (Marketing): Heads-up: Redwood + SummitCloud are coordinating a co-marketing push for the Edge Adapter. Scope: SummitCloud marketplace listing, a short bench post, and a 1-hr intro webinar. Need ops checklist + inbound lead flow. Who volunteers for parts?
Ivy (Growth): I can do webinar logistics and landing page. Tentative webinar date: May 12 (midday PT). OK?
Tomas (Demand Gen): May 12 works if listing and bench post are live a week earlier. Routing: all marketplace leads must land in our SFDC queue with source=summitcloud_marketplace.
Lee (Sales): Sales routing: assign to flow "marketplace-queue" and tag for SDR follow-up. SDR owner: Priya. Need JSON example for webhook to map fields.
Ravi (Product): I'll produce the benchmark: p95/p99 latency, throughput at batch sizes 1/8/16, and cost-per-10k tokens. Will drop raw numbers and commands by EOD Tue.
Marketplace Bot: Listing state: partner review requested (https://summitcloud.example/review/edge-adapter).
Nora (Marketing): Landing page CTA suggestion: "Deploy Redwood Edge Adapter — fast inference, predictable cost". UTM scheme: utm_source=summitcloud&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=edge-adapter.
Ivy (Growth): Form fields: name, email, company, role, cloud_region, use_case. Map to our analytics:
```json
{
  "name": "full_name",
  "email": "email",
  "company": "company",
  "role": "job_title",
  "region": "cloud_region",
  "use_case": "use_case",
  "source": "summitcloud",
  "utm": "{{utm}}"
}
```
Tomas (Demand Gen): Flow: Summit webhook -> Eventbridge -> inbound lambda -> Segment -> SFDC. Lambda should enrich with company_size via Clearbit and set lead.Owner = "marketplace-queue" and lead.Type = "Marketplace". Add tag: partner:summitcloud.
Lee (Sales): Priya wants leads with >25 employees flagged. Enrichment step OK?
Ravi (Product): Yes, lambda can call Clearbit lookup and include employee_count. Threshold check will add lead.Score = 10 for >25.
Nora (Marketing): Draft bench blurb: "In our tests the SummitCloud Edge Adapter cut p99 latency by ~35% at 2k tokens versus the baseline and reduced per-call inference cost by ~28% when using batching and prefix caching." Suggestions?
Ivy (Growth): Add one line about deployment modes: "Available via Redwood hosted API or as a VPC-deployable adapter for private workloads."
Tomas (Demand Gen): Email nurture sequence: 1) listing -> sign-up confirmation with webinar invite + one-pager link; 2) pre-webinar reminder; 3) post-webinar email with bench blog + trial CTA. Need copy assets and UTM links.
Nora (Marketing): Who writes the confirmation email? Ivy? Also need speaker list for webinar: Ravi (product), Nora (marketing), and SummitCloud engineer (TBD). Ivy can handle speaker outreach?
Ivy (Growth): I will contact SummitCloud and coordinate the speaker. Also will draft confirmation email copy.
Lee (Sales): Action: draft SDR playbook for marketplace leads (first-touch script, follow-up cadence). I'll drop the doc in the sales folder by Thu.
Ravi (Product): Demo script outline: 1) install adapter; 2) show 30s cold start; 3) run benchmark comparison at seq=2048; 4) show cost calc. Commands to run locally I'll post:
```bash
python bench.py --adapter=edge --model=redwood --seq=2048 --batches=100
```
Nora (Marketing): Ops checklist (initial):
- Partner listing review (Tomas) 1 Apr
- Listing go-live (Marketplace Bot) 6 Apr
- Benchmark draft (Ravi) 9 Apr
- Blog review (Marketing + Legal) 2 May
- Landing page + form (Ivy) 6 Apr
- Webinar invites (Ivy) 2 Apr
- Lambda routing + enrichment (Tomas/Eng) 5 Apr
- SDR playbook (Lee) 4 Apr
- Post-webinar assets + amplification (Marketing) 3 May

Nora (Marketing): Please confirm with a one-line "I own X 61" below so I can add to the calendar.
Tomas (Demand Gen): I own partner listing review + routing lambda sign-off 61
Ivy (Growth): I own landing page, webinar ops, speaker outreach, and confirmation email 61
Ravi (Product): I own benchmark numbers, demo script, and slides 61
Lee (Sales): I own SDR playbook and triage rules 61
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: ops checklist reminder Apr 25 09:00 UTC.
